title: Your Will
lyrics_original: Your presence Lord, is my treasure,
It soothes and carries me through pain.
Your will alone is my pleasure,
My joy although I may be slain.
Your Will, Lord Your will
How I long for Your will!
May my heart ever blend
With Your will! Amen.
Willingly I yield my heart,
And trust Your ways are always good.
The darkest clouds of doubt depart,
When from myself to Christ I look.
Your Will, Lord Your will
How I long for Your will!
May my heart ever blend
With Your will! Amen.
The way Your Spirit moves and guides
Is holy and unsearchable,
So teach me how to glorify,
And please You from my inmost soul.
Your Will, Lord Your will
How I long for Your will!
May my heart ever blend
With Your will! Amen.
Though heavy trials You may send,
The joy You give’s unspeakable,
You cause my heart to rest content,
For I know that You are in control.
Your Will, Lord Your will
How I long for Your will!
May my heart ever blend
With Your will! Amen.
Your Will, Lord Your will
How I long for Your will!
May my heart ever blend
With Your will! Amen.
author_english: J.M. Inspired by the Romanian song, Voia Ta

bible_verses.english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forevermore.
May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, Your presence is the deepest treasure of my heart, sustaining me through every trial. Today, I willingly surrender my plans to You, trusting that Your ways are always good and true. Teach my heart to blend seamlessly with Your will, even when the road ahead is unclear. May Your purpose be fulfilled in my life today. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, Your presence is the deepest treasure of my heart, sustaining me through every trial. devotional.reflection_english: Finding peace in God's will is not a forced surrender, but a joyful response to His overwhelming love and presence. Even through pain and uncertainty, His presence remains our greatest treasure, comforting and carrying us forward. As we lift our voices to ask for His will to be done, we learn to trust that His ways are always good and faithful. May our hearts gently align with His today, willingly yielding every desire into the safe hands of our Savior.
